name: jengo/api
description: Automated REST API engine for the Jengo framework. Provides automatic CRUD routing, OpenAPI/Swagger generation, transactional relationship mutations, dynamic FormHandler payload validations, Sqids-based URL ID obfuscation, version namespace prefix grouping, and CodeIgniter Shield authentication integration.

routing.description: Stateful, chainable route publisher that registers dynamic REST paths and Swagger endpoints for exposed Jengo API resources.

methods.publish: publish(RouteCollection $routes, ?RouterOptions $options = null): Router (registers routes and returns a Router instance for chaining)
methods.mutate: mutate(RouterOptions $overrides): Router (creates a cloned Router instance with overrides applied, automatically publishing the new versioned routes)

options.description: DTO defining route publication filters, active version, and documentation routing parameters.

properties.except: array of HTTP verbs to exclude from routing
properties.only: array of HTTP verbs to exclusively register
properties.version: version prefix (e.g. 'v1') to namespace the routes group
properties.docs: instance of DocsOptions defining documentation configurations

options.description: DTO defining routes and visibility for Swagger JSON and the interactive UI.

properties.route: string route prefix for documentation JSON (default: 'docs'), or false to disable
properties.uiRoute: string route prefix for interactive Swagger UI (default: 'docs/ui'), or false to disable

resources.description: Abstract base class for defining Jengo API policies, Sqids obfuscation rules, validation mappings, and lifecycle hooks. NOTE: To obfuscate database primary/foreign keys (e.g. 'id' or 'user_id'), the database Entity must extend Jengo\Base\Entities\BaseEntity and declare those fields inside its protected array $obfuscatedFields, and those same fields must be declared inside the ResourceConfig's protected array $obfuscatedFields.

properties.formClass: FormHandler class name to validate request body inputs
properties.capabilities: array of allowed GET query parameters (pagination, search, sort)
properties.allowedRelations: array of allowed relation derivations to load dynamically
properties.maxLimit: integer cap for maximum GET collection limits (default: 100)
properties.obfuscatedFields: array of fields to encode/decode using Sqids
properties.version: string, array, or null version matching restriction (e.g. 'v1' or ['v1', 'v2'])
properties.requiredAuth: array mapping HTTP verbs to required permissions (e.g. ['get' => 'users.read', 'post' => true])

methods.beforeSave: beforeSave(array $data, ?HookContext $context = null): array (runs prior to creating/updating records to mutate payload)
methods.afterSave: afterSave(array $record, ?HookContext $context = null): array (runs after record write triggers to transform output)
methods.beforeQuery: beforeQuery($query, ?HookContext $context = null): void (runs prior to database select to inject custom criteria)
methods.afterQuery: afterQuery(array $data, ?HookContext $context = null): array (runs after database select to filter or enrich return collections)

resources.description: DTO injected into lifecycle hooks carrying request-specific information.

properties.version: string active version prefix of the request (e.g. 'v1')

views.description: Namespace-resolved view file rendering the interactive Swagger UI and binding the documentation JSON endpoint URL.

commands.name: jengo:api setup
commands.description: Initial setup command for the API package. Publishes the JengoApi configuration class inheriting from BaseJengoApi and registers routes inside app/Config/Routes.php.

commands.name: jengo:make api_resource <name>
commands.description: Generates a new ResourceConfig class boilerplate, with full support for CodeIgniter code modules.
